about.title: About
about.intro: Animator, illustrator and storyteller with a love for worlds that sit just outside the ordinary.
about.storyTitle: I create work that pulls you somewhere else for a moment.
about.storyOne: I'm Lisa-Marij, also known as LMtapes. As a Dutch animator and illustrator, I love creating visual stories where atmosphere, character and imagination take the lead.
about.storyTwo: My work moves between animation and illustration. I'm drawn to creating worlds and characters that feel familiar, while still carrying something strange, tense or unexpected.
